html:
East Germany, the German Democratic Republic, was a communist state in central Europe from 1949 to 1990, built from the Soviet occupation zone. Its capital was East Berlin.

The Socialist Unity Party held all real power, first under Walter Ulbricht and from 1971 under Erich Honecker. Its secret police, the Stasi, kept files on millions of its own people. When workers protested against higher work quotas in the uprising of 1953, Soviet tanks crushed them.

Millions left for the West through Berlin. In 1961, a year after this map, the regime sealed the city with the Berlin Wall. East Germany became the richest country in the Soviet bloc and a sporting power, but lagged far behind West Germany.

In 1989 mass protests and an exodus through Hungary broke the regime. The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989, and on 3 October 1990 East Germany joined the Federal Republic in German reunification.
sum: East Germany, the German Democratic Republic, was a communist state in central Europe from 1949 to 1990, built from the Soviet occupation zone. Its capital was East Berlin.
